errors.description: Reports more than 800 professionals, but the source reports more than 800 baseline attempts; it does not establish that many distinct people.
Says qualitative analyses show the primary drivers of progress without preserving that this is interpretation from a small sample of unsuccessful transcripts rather than causal decomposition.

The opening defines sensitivity as the probability that the test is ill when the person is ill. The later calculation makes the intended positive-test definition clear, so this is a local definition/wording error rather than a wrong PPV.

Calling preferentially detected slow disease often harmless and contrasting it with dangerous cases often detected late pushes the length-bias explanation beyond the dossier’s narrower selection mechanism.
Presents missing context and cleanup as the reason for the randomized slowdown, where the source presents observations and plausible mechanisms without proving a single cause.
States that organizations with the listed capabilities benefit more and absent structures cause instability without preserving the observational moderation and local-experiment limits.
Saying that error rate rises when reliability requirements rise confuses a stricter required success threshold with a changed error rate at a fixed task duration.
Calls the field-study tools current without preserving the February–June 2025 treatment period.
Presents the attributed primary drivers of improvement without making clear that the supporting evidence is a small qualitative analysis rather than a measured causal decomposition.

The claim that only fewer target-disease deaths establish effectiveness narrows the dossier’s broader benefit-harm outcomes, and the wording about excluding all listed biases through an RCT is stronger than the dossier’s qualified design guidance.

The opening allows verification to be left to human intuition as an alternative to robust processes, contradicting the personal requirement for a dependable review/verification process and the later mandatory tests.
Presents repository-context/cleanup observations as the explanation for the field-study slowdown without retaining the study’s limits on causal mechanism attribution.
Turns the number of baseline attempts into the number of distinct expert participants, which is not established by the paper.

Applies the introduction’s criticism of artificial, economically unvaluable older benchmarks to the study’s task distribution without distinguishing its deliberately realistic HCAST/RE-Bench projects from the short atomic tasks.
Introduces NNT and NNS together and describes both as numbers screened; this conflates the unrequested measures rather than adding grounded endpoint evidence.

The closing phrase that probability changes in a different direction from what a layperson expects is misleading: the supplied numbers raise disease probability from 1% to 15.4%; the disagreement with 90% concerns magnitude.
Reports a 19-percent productivity increase where the randomized study found 19-percent longer implementation time. This reverses a central empirical result.
Initially reports unchanged DORA delivery instability, while the source reports increased instability and the final paragraph itself later mentions that increase.
Uses 24 percent for developers’ perceived improvement before and after the study; the recorded after-study estimate was 20 percent.
Calls management tasks more complex without support and describes the historical million-dollar payout pool as an agent budget.

methodology.agent: One native bounded attempt per cell. Tool-error recovery within an attempt is not a restarted benchmark attempt.
methodology.artifact_metadata: Exact digests identify the deployed weights. Empty runtime quantization/parameter-size metadata remains unknown; no value is inferred from a model tag.
methodology.claims: Single-observation capability screen, not reliability probabilities or a universal model ranking.
methodology.interrupted_usage: Native Pi token usage summarizes completed message events; a budget-interrupted response can have streamed content without a final usage event. Preserve native counters and do not claim complete token totals for interrupted episodes.
methodology.native_checks: LinkedIn heading_pass false is preserved as a generic diagnostic; the frozen writing rubric does not require headings and adds no heading-based quality cap.
methodology.postflight: Every native block records an empty model list after unloading its own model.
methodology.quality: Task-specific scalar judgments and conditional pairwise checks frozen before model reveal; partial interactive blinding because orchestration timing/progress was visible. Log/supplier prose reviewed separately without blinding.
methodology.resource_gates: Fresh thirty-second empty-model/process checks per native block; fresh Pi sandbox acceptance.
methodology.text: One cold/warm pair per task and deployment. Warm is the sole quality candidate.
methodology.timing: Native provider/active timings retain their own units. Controller time excludes preparation/resource/sandbox checks and model unload, but includes native verification and CLI orchestration.

request_count.rule: Pi agent turns are not HTTP request counts; unknowns are not zero.

source_review.supplier_language_rule: German free-text values required by the frozen TASK-v0.2; reviewed separately from native code/anchor checks.
